faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp.

items.a: Add brownies to your cart (or build a box), fill in your delivery details and tap "Place order on WhatsApp". WhatsApp opens with your full order ready — just press send and we'll confirm.
There's no payment on the website. Once we confirm your order on WhatsApp, we'll share UPI details. We start baking once payment is received.
Across Chennai for a flat ₹{charge}. Pincodes starting with {prefixes} are accepted.
Small orders can be delivered from the next day. For more than {threshold} pieces in total, please pick a date at least {days} days ahead so everything is baked fresh.
Our healthy range uses wheat, pearl millet (kambu), ragi or health mix instead of maida. Look for the "Healthy" badge.
No. Everything is homemade with no preservatives, which is why we bake fresh for each order.

items.q: How long do brownies stay fresh?
items.a: Our brownies have a shelf life of {shelfLife}. Keep them in an airtight box; in Chennai heat the fridge is best. Warm for 10 seconds before eating.

items.q: How does Build Your Box work?
items.a: Choose a 4-piece (₹260) or 6-piece (₹390) box, tap the flavours you want until the box is full, then add it to your cart. You can mix any flavours.
Yes. Our FSSAI licence number is {fssai}.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp as soon as possible. Changes are possible until we start baking.
